notes.title: Small Update 1: Audio Sliders
notes.notes:
1.) Added audio sliders to let you boost the volume of music and SFX by another 40%.
2.) Fixed an English typo in Chapter 7: "go ourside the circle." -> "go outside the circle."
3.) Fixed a rare stuck bug in the marble game (Chapter 7).

notes.title: Quick fix 3: Apply FPS Cap
notes.notes: Unintended behaviors are seen when the game runs at high FPS. Limiting the maximum frame rate to 60 to ensure consistency across devices of different specs.

notes.title: Paper Ghost Stories: Third Eye Open release date announce!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're thrilled to announce that Third Eye Open is nearing completing and today we can announce that the game will be launching on 5th September 2024! Check out our release date announcement trailer: 
[previewyoutube=UOVUfkEAEvc;full][/previewyoutube]

Third Eye Open has been in development for over 4 years, since we finished work on the first game, Paper Ghost Stories: 7PM. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426789/3294d2a1d771f0bca20e23ca11a935d5ce59b17a.gif[/img]

The game tells the story of Ting, a young girl growing up in sometimes difficult circumstances, who has the extraordinary ability to see the souls of the recently departed. Will they aid her or harm her? What future will YOU decide for her as you navigate her family and friendships?

We're using the same papercraft-inspired art style that we used in 7PM to tell Ting's story this time around. It's inspired by our native Southeast Asian culture and every frame of animation and every detail is painstakingly hand-drawn to create make it feel like papercraft come to life.

Please Wishlist the game now on our Steam page as it really helps us! The game will also release on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Xbox.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42426789/cde971d001fbd39737fc8c78d55794104a41e004.gif[/img]

Thanks for your support over the years and we can't wait for you to start experiencing Ting's journey for yourselves.

Thanks,
Cellar Vault Games

notes.title: This papercraft ghost story game is beautiful to just walk around in
notes.notes:
A story about a girl who has a ghost best friend nobody else can see, and has to juggle that relationship with her interactions with living people? Sounds fake. Haha, but seriously folks. There's a demo for Paper Ghost Stories: Third Eye Open in the Steam Next Fest, and boy howdy did I like just looking at this game in motion. The clue is in the name, as all the characters look like 2D paper cut out dolls, and all the environments are like papercraft models. It's pretty gorge.

Third Eye Open, out this year, is inspired by the Joss-Papercraft of Southeast Asia (indeed, the start menu is a stage). You play as Ting, a pre-adolescent girl living in Malaysia with her parents. Ting discovers her supernatural ability to see ghosts at a camp, where she meets Xiu, a ghost girl about her own age. The two become friends, and the demo starts in media res when the two are back home.

notes.title: Play the brand new demo for Third Eye Open!
notes.notes:
As part of the LudoNarraCon event we are very excited to share a brand new demo for [i]Paper Ghost Stories: Third Eye Open[/i]. This is the first time we have had a playable demo on Steam for the game and we are excited for you to try it out. 

In this demo you will get a taste of what life is like for our young protagonist Ting as she wrestles with her ability to see and communicate with the spirits around her. You'll meet some of Ting's friends as well as her ghostly companion, Xiu, as they set out on a seemingly normal day... until they enter a creepy abandoned house... 

You can find out more in this new trailer too:

[previewyoutube=jG_AEd42nRU;full][/previewyoutube]

Please let us know what you think of the demo, or report any issues, in the discussions. 

If you like what you have seen, don't forget to wishlist and follow the game! 

Finally, if you can't wait to play more [i]Paper Ghost Stories[/i] you can even buy our previous, bite-sized installment, [i]Paper Ghost Stories: 7PM[/i] during the LudoNarraCon sale.  

We hope you enjoy playing the game,

CVG team
